Rule-veto policy, chosen after seeing the golden results: unsafe auto-handle 0.16 (LLM only) -> 0.07 (with veto) on the full set; on 200 random held-out halves the reduction is 0.095 on average (5th-95th percentile 0.044 to 0.146).
